price_note: Every product is $1 for the hackathon demo / test phase.

products.name: Trailhead Waterproof Hiking Boots
products.desc: Rugged waterproof hiking boots with grippy lugged soles, ankle support and a cushioned insole for long trails.
products.short: Waterproof leather hiking boots for rough trails.
products.fit: True to size. Wide fit available in-store only — not in this demo catalog.

products.name: City Chelsea Rain Boots
products.desc: Sleek pull-on Chelsea boots that shrug off rain and puddles, with elastic side panels and a low stacked heel.
products.fit: True to size. Narrower than the Trailhead boots.

products.name: Boardwalk Leather Sandals
products.desc: Classic two-strap leather sandals with a moulded cork footbed that shapes to your foot.
products.short: Classic tan leather sandals with a cork footbed.
products.fit: True to size. Break in over 2–3 wears.

products.name: Cloudstep Sport Sandals
products.desc: Lightweight sport sandals with adjustable straps and a soft EVA sole — built for river walks and hot days.
products.short: Lightweight teal sport sandals, adjustable straps.
products.fit: Runs slightly large — consider half a size down.

products.name: Court Classic White Sneakers
products.desc: A clean, minimal white court sneaker that goes with everything. Leather upper, padded collar, rubber cupsole.

products.name: Retro High-Top Sneakers
products.desc: Bold cherry-red high-tops with a retro basketball silhouette, canvas upper and ankle padding.
products.fit: True to size. High-top fit — ankle support, less flex.

products.name: Fireside Wool Slippers
products.desc: Warm wool-felt house slippers with a suede sole — warm enough for winter mornings, quiet on hard floors.
products.short: Warm charcoal wool slippers with a suede sole.
products.fit: True to size. Wool will mould slightly with wear.

products.name: Cloud Plush House Slippers
products.desc: Ridiculously soft navy plush slippers with memory-foam insoles and a non-slip rubber sole for indoor/outdoor steps.
products.short: Soft navy plush slippers, memory-foam insoles.
products.fit: Runs slightly small — consider half a size up.

products.name: Velocity Road Runners
products.desc: Lightweight road runners in electric blue, with breathable engineered mesh and responsive EVA cushioning. The hero demo product: size 9.5 in blue.
products.short: Lightweight blue road runners, EVA cushioning.
products.fit: True to size. Best for road running and daily training.

products.name: Trailblazer Trail Runners
products.desc: Trail runners with an aggressive tread, rock plate and ripstop mesh — built for mud, roots and loose gravel.
products.short: Orange trail runners with aggressive tread.
products.fit: True to size. Half a size up if you wear thick trail socks.

products.name: Marathon Knit Runners
products.desc: Sock-like knit runners in black and white, with a soft foam midsole for long, easy miles.
products.fit: True to size. Knit upper stretches slightly.

products.name: Everyday Comfort Runners
products.desc: Easy, cushioned sage-green runners for walking, errands and all-day wear — not a race shoe, a comfort shoe.
products.short: Sage-green comfort runners for all-day wear.
products.fit: True to size. Roomy toe box.
